title: 3.1 Greetings and Names
unit_outcome: Introduce yourself and others in Spanish: name, age, where you are from, your job and what you have.
goal: Greet someone, say goodbye, ask a name with ¿Cómo te llamas? and answer with Me llamo…
grammar_function: ¿Cómo te llamas? Me llamo + name; Hola/Adiós/Buenos días.
speaking_outcome: Greet someone and say your name.
